title: Describing and Evaluating Media
summary: Comparing, evaluating, and reacting to films, series, and media habits.
whyItMatters: A clear media recommendation gives enough context, identifies strengths and weaknesses, and considers the listener's interests.

mentalModel.title: Premise, feature, judgment
mentalModel.content: Briefly describe the work, point to a specific feature, and evaluate its effect.

mentalModel.title: Recommend for an audience
mentalModel.content: Say who may enjoy it and which preferences or limits matter.

ruleBlocks.title: Give a spoiler-light description
ruleBlocks.content: Name genre, setting, main conflict, and tone without revealing the ending.

ruleBlocks.title: Use criteria
ruleBlocks.content: Discuss story, characters, acting, images, music, pace, originality, and clarity.

ruleBlocks.title: Compare one dimension at a time
ruleBlocks.content: Use genauso, besser als, weniger, zwar aber, and im Vergleich zu.

tables.title: Media Review Toolkit
rows: Ich habe mich besonders über ... gefreut.
Die Serie passt zu Leuten, die ...

examples.de: Die Serie handelt von drei Freunden, die zusammen ein Café eröffnen.
examples.en: The series is about three friends who open a café together.

examples.de: Besonders gut fand ich die Dialoge, weil sie natürlich wirken.
examples.en: I especially liked the dialogue because it feels natural.

examples.de: Der Film ist weniger spannend als der erste Teil, aber die Figuren sind interessanter.
examples.en: The film is less exciting than the first part, but the characters are more interesting.

commonMistakes.correct: Summarize the premise and focus on evaluation.
commonMistakes.reason: A review is not a full plot summary.

commonMistakes.wrong: Recommend a work without considering the audience.
commonMistakes.correct: Name who is likely to enjoy it.

comparisons.summary: The theme supplies genre, habit, and content vocabulary.
Reflexive forms express reactions and interests naturally.
